title: Made a 4-player co-op zombies game that runs in your browser, built with Claude
author: Aggravating_Fun_3912
selftext:
grew up playing bo2 and bo3 zombies with my friends and always wanted to make my own. so i did with claude

its free, runs in your browser on pc or phone, no download. solo or up to 4 players, and quick play matches you with randoms.

put it out two days ago and a couple hundred people have played. two strangers who found each other through quick play made it to round 25 together in a 90 minute game. that one made my week.

would love to hear what you think, good or bad

[https://deadhertz.com/?ref=aigamedev](https://deadhertz.com/?ref=aigamedev)

comments.author: TranqyPoo
comments.body: A very good game for a browser (and free!)
